grammar.title: Giving directions: Ga rechtdoor!
points: The imperative (an order or instruction) is just the stem of the verb: gaan → ga, nemen → neem, kijken → kijk.
It's the same for one person or more, and for jij and u: Ga rechtdoor! Neem de tweede straat.
With a separable verb the prefix goes to the end: oversteken → Steek de straat over.
Add alstublieft (or a friendly tone) to sound polite: Neem de eerste straat links, alstublieft.

examples.en: Take the second street on the left.

dialogue.scene: A tourist asks Sara the way to the bakery.
